sources.title: qwen-mt-plus Model Info
sources.evidence: Exact Plus model page identifies the Qwen3-derived flagship translation model, 92 languages, terminology control, text input/output, function calling unsupported, and a 16,384-token context with 8,192 input and output limits. It does not disclose parameter counts or dense versus MoE structure.

sources.title: Machine translation (Qwen-MT)
sources.evidence: Describes Qwen-MT as fine-tuned from Qwen3 and explicitly lists Plus as a 92-language translation offering. Documents hosted API usage, terminology intervention, domain prompts and translation memory; no Plus weight release or weight license is identified.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Lists the Qwen3-upgraded qwen-mt-plus on 2025-07-22 in Beijing and 2025-07-24 for international/global deployment. These are region-specific upgrade/availability dates, not proof of the first historical release of the unversioned alias.

sources.title: Text generation model capabilities
sources.evidence: The exact qwen-mt-plus row marks thinking mode, function calling, built-in tools and structured output unsupported.

sources.title: Qwen-MT: Where Speed Meets Smart Translation
sources.evidence: July 24, 2025 announcement explicitly introduces the qwen-mt-turbo update. It is not exact-variant evidence for Plus parameter counts or its dense-versus-MoE architecture.

sources.title: Models.dev qwen-mt-plus record
sources.evidence: Baseline catalog source was followed; its claims were checked against developer documentation rather than treated as primary technical evidence.

name.note: Display-name normalization of official Qwen-MT-Plus; exact API identifier is qwen-mt-plus.

developer.note: Official Alibaba Cloud documentation presents this as its Qwen translation model.

family.note: Explicitly part of the Qwen series; current translation model derives from Qwen3.

release_date.note: Verified for the Qwen3 upgrade in international/global deployment. Beijing lists 2025-07-22. Keep baseline date only with this scope; these entries do not establish the first historical release of the unversioned alias.

open_weights.note: Reviewed primary sources document hosted API access but do not explicitly establish closed weights or provide a downloadable Plus checkpoint. API access alone does not prove weight availability; baseline false is not independently verified.

license.note: No model-weight license is disclosed in the reviewed exact-model documentation. Do not transfer a license from open Qwen3 checkpoints.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter count is disclosed for the exact hosted Plus model. Qwen3 lineage does not identify a particular open model size.

active_parameters_b.note: No active parameter count is disclosed. Do not equate it with a total count or copy an open Qwen3 count.

architecture.note: Qwen3 derivation is established, but the exact Plus dense/MoE topology is not disclosed. The blog identifies Turbo, so its architectural claims cannot establish Plus architecture.

context_window.note: Explicit context window in tokens; maximum input and output are each 8,192.

modalities.note: Exact-model capability table lists text for both input and output.

reasoning.note: The exact-model capability table explicitly marks thinking mode unsupported.

description.value: Flagship Qwen translation model with terminology control and support for 92 languages
description.note: All factual elements match the exact-model documentation; flagship is the developer designation.

sources.label: Alibaba model lifecycle and regional dates

patch.notes: 2025-07-24 is the international/global availability date of the Qwen3 upgrade; Beijing lists 2025-07-22. Total and active parameters and dense/MoE topology are undisclosed for Plus. The July 24 Qwen blog specifically introduces Turbo. Reviewed primary documentation establishes API access but not the weight-release status or a model-weight license.

summary: Verified name, developer, family, international Qwen3-upgrade date, description, 16,384-token context, text I/O, and unsupported thinking/function calling. Parameters and dense/MoE architecture remain null. Regional date ambiguity is documented. Open-weight status is changed to unknown because the reviewed exact-model primary sources establish API access without an explicit weight-release statement; license remains null.
